name: OpenBot Activity
author: danyakmallun
description: Live OpenBot agent activity in the Omarchy bar: a pill that shows which agent is working, how long it has been going, and when one is waiting on you, plus a panel with the current step, pending questions, and the turns that just finished.

barWidget.description: Working, waiting, and asking states for every OpenBot agent, read live from the local OpenBot database.

schema.label: Idle refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar reads OpenBot while idle. While an agent is working it always reads once a second.

schema.label: Finished flash (seconds)
schema.description: How long the pill keeps showing a check after a turn ends.

schema.label: Silent-turn warning (seconds)
schema.description: A running turn with no new step for this long is shown as silent instead of working.
